plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Skills, plugins, and config for AI coding agents

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: Comprehensive hook logging - tracks tool usage, sessions, turns, prompts, subagents, compactions, notifications, and permissions with JSONL files and optional Loki push.

plugins.name: skill-router
plugins.description: Injects a skill-routing meta-skill at session start. A hooks module refuses high-signal commands (git commit, gh pr create, npm install, rm -rf, ...) until the matching skill has loaded, and asks the person to approve external or destructive ones.

plugins.name: secret-mask
plugins.description: Mod that swaps secrets for placeholders before they reach the model and puts them back only in tool calls you approve.
